issues.problem: The upholstered bench is covered across nearly its entire seating width by lanterns, notebooks, a bottle and a pen holder, leaving no practical place to sit.
issues.fix: Move these loose items to suitable storage or display surfaces, keeping the required lantern obj_0038 on the bench near one end and clearing a usable seating area.

issues.problem: The floor instruments line the front of bench obj_0049, while the perpendicular bench already restricts its other end. This leaves too little clear approach and foot space for comfortable seating.
issues.fix: Reposition the three instruments together near an end of the bench, outside its main seating approach. Preserve obj_0032 between the other two and within 0.1 m of obj_0049.

fixes.reason: reviewer did not prefer the change in both orders

votes.reason: Both arrangements preserve the hard constraints and keep the moved objects fully supported on the bench without overlaps.
